import sys, json
d = json.load(sys.stdin)["body"]
calls = [m for m in d.get("messages", []) if m.get("type") == "tool_call"]
if not calls:
    sys.stdout.write(json.dumps({"messages": []})); sys.exit(0)
c = calls[0]
args = json.loads(c.get("text", "{}")).get("arguments", {})
if isinstance(args, str):
    args = json.loads(args or "{}")
topic = str(args.get("topic", "")).strip().lower()
FACTS = {
    "meclaw": "meclaw is a framework for building agentic harnesses as a directory tree.",
    "rust": "Rust is a systems language with memory safety and no garbage collector.",
    "tokio": "Tokio is an asynchronous runtime for Rust, built on cooperative tasks.",
    "actor model": "The actor model isolates state in actors that talk only via messages.",
}
fact = FACTS.get(topic, "No fact on file for '%s'." % topic)
result = {"origin": "tool", "type": "tool_result", "id": c.get("id", "call"), "text": fact}
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps({"messages": [c, result]}))
